The denim we’re famous for

The great autumn reset

Neutral homeware

Best-in-class uniform

Back-to-school essentials

There are lots of good reasons why M&S is your go-to brand. Think always-on-trend fashion, luxurious beauty essentials and food you’ll find hard to resist. We focus on quality while keeping things affordable with everyday value and offers, so you can shop with confidence for every member of the family. Our trusted finance products, from insurance to credit cards, mean we even have money covered. So where would you like to begin?

Whether you’re heading to work, packing for a holiday or dressing youngsters for busy days, you’ll find all the clothing you need at Marks & Spencer. We have supportive lingerie and flattering separates for women, alongside sharp tailoring and casual footwear for men. When it comes to the kids, we know that comfort and durability are key. That’s why we use soft fabrics and innovative technology for everything from school uniform and underwear to outfits for newborns.

Our home and furniture department is packed with big and small items to make every room comfortable. Pick from sets of fluffy towels in a rainbow of colours when the bathroom needs a refresh. To make sure there’s a place for everything in the kitchen, explore our handy storage solutions. Keen chefs will be inspired to try new recipes and serve them up in style, thanks to our professional-standard pans and elegant tableware. The finishing touches come in the form of uplifting flowers and plants, all sourced from growers we know and trust.

When it’s time to sit down and eat, you can choose old favourites and brand-new recipes from our food catalogue. All of our ingredients, from seafood to fruit, are carefully chosen, so you always get the best. On chilly days, hearty soups, warming stews and indulgent puds hit the spot. For fuss-free hosting, order sandwich platters and choose picky bits to keep guests happy. Our selection of food and wine includes celebration cakes and crates of fizz to get the party started.
